# Complete Exterior Care

## Services

- [Graffiti Removal](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/complete-exterior-care-llc/services/graffiti-removal/): chemical and pressure removal. $200–$800
- [Dryer Vent Cleaning](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/complete-exterior-care-llc/services/dryer-vent-cleaning/): full vent line clearing. $120–$250
- [Commercial Pressure Washing](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/complete-exterior-care-llc/services/commercial-washing/): storefronts, sidewalks, lots, drive-thrus. Quoted by square footage
- [Rust & Stain Removal](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/complete-exterior-care-llc/services/rust-stain-removal/): rust, oil, and organic staining. $200–$600
